identity: The Frostbarrow mines dig where it is coldest and most dangerous; leopards stalk the sled tracks, pinchers hold the icy shore, and a goblin counts stolen blasting powder in the rimewood.

quests.title: No Bell on Those Cats
quests.text: I can hear a loaded sled through a gale, but a Tarn Cat gives no warning before it pounces. Kill eight Tarn Cats at night along the sled track in the {name:pinewood}, which lies {zone_area:pinewood}. Folk hauling our supplies deserve to arrive with nothing worse to complain of than cold toes.

quests.title: Optional: Pinched Runners
quests.text: Bank Crabs have taken a liking to the sled landing on the {name:shingle} {dir_from_giver:shingle}, and to the runners of anything parked there. Clear six of them by day if you can spare the time. They only pinch back, but they mean it.
quests.lesson: Optional daytime shore strip beside the night hunt.

quests.title: An Extra Pair for Kelda
quests.text: Kelda Screesort says Tarncut Mine is managing, which means she's doing three dwarves' work and resenting the other two. Go speak with her there and say Edda sent you. She'll grumble, but she'll find a use for willing hands.

quests.title: A Lantern at Rimebell
quests.text: Hedra Rimebell keeps the signal lantern at Rimebell Watch, and she sees trouble on the shore long before it reaches the sleds. Walk up and tell her Edda sent you; a watch with one pair of eyes needs a second pair of hands.
quests.lesson: Handoff to the zone's third hub.

quests.title: Horns Have Right of Way
quests.text: I spent half the morning hauling a sled back onto the track while a Curlhorn Ram watched me chew my beard. Cull six Curlhorn Rams by day along the haul lane in the {name:snowpines}, which lie {zone_area:snowpines}. They graze quietly until challenged, so take your time choosing the fight; I've already supplied the temper.
quests.lesson: Neutral grazers in the middle belt.

quests.title: What Holds the Roof
quests.text: Every dwarf looks at the ore; a good miner looks at what's holding the roof above it. Bring me four Steel Bars for the deep shaft's brackets. I'll give you a Steel Pickaxe for the rock down there, and we'll both have done something useful before lunch.
quests.lesson: Steel from the dual furnace; the steel pick opens tier three rock.

quests.title: Bring Yourself Back Too
quests.text: Take your Steel Pickaxe deep beneath these mines, below the copper and jade, and bring me two pieces of Rough Garnet. Pack food, carry light and keep a route back to the surface. I count a trip successful when the stone and the miner both come back up; one without the other is just paperwork.

quests.title: An Explosive Miscalculation
quests.text: Goblin Powder-Counter Nib stole our blasting powder and is counting the barrels in the {name:rimewood} {dir_from_giver:powder_counter_nib}. Go by daylight, when the leopards there have bedded down and only rams and the odd eagle are about. Clear your approach first, then pull Nib away from his barrels and fight him alone; he hits like a goblin who knows exactly how much powder he has left. Kill him before he finishes his sums.
quests.lesson: Normal named leader at the top of the zone.

quests.title: A Miner for Splitbolt
quests.text: With Nib's sums settled, Tarncut can dig again without flinching at every echo. Borin Splitbolt holds Splitbolt Station in Stormvault Heights, where the Accord needs dwarves who keep their heads under falling stone. Go and report to him; tell him Kelda says you came back up every time.
quests.lesson: Heartland to contested zone handoff at 30.

quests.title: The Landing Bites Back
quests.text: A landing should let you get out of a boat, not persuade you to climb back in. Kill six Barnacle Pinchers on the {name:icy_shore} {dir_from_giver:icy_shore} by day. They'll attack without waiting for an invitation, so get your footing before you get their attention.

quests.title: Optional: Eyes in the Rimewood
quests.text: From the watch I count fresh tracks every night in the {name:rimewood}, which lies {zone_area:rimewood}, and every one of them belongs to a Tarn Cat. Kill six there after dark if you've the nerve and the hours. Nobody will order you to, which is why I'm asking nicely.
quests.lesson: Optional night hunt of the top belt.

quests.title: Two Hands on the Seal
quests.text: The anthracite and garnet orders are filled; this ordinary delivery copy has the guild and military supply office's joint seal on it. Take this delivery copy to Hadrin Beamset at the Miner's Guild house in Dur Brannoc so The Charter of Stone can record it.
quests.completion: That joint seal is ours and the army supply office's: The Charter of Stone confirms the load, and they confirm its place in the supply plan. Both sides put their names to work they can answer for.

quests.notes: Round 58 follow-up of tier 3 (The Charter of Stone): story seed: The player carries an ordinary delivery copy confirmed by the guild and the supply office; the leader explains their joint seal (Charter of Stone) or their joint register marks (Oathdelvers).

quests.title: A Load on Every Back
quests.text: Cliffbuck has taken to charging our haulers between the pines, where there is precious little room to dodge. Hunt eight Cliffbuck in the pinewoods of {name:pinewood}, {zone_area:pinewood}, by day. A man can carry a load or climb a tree; asking for both seems unfair.

variants.text: Cliffbuck has taken to charging our haulers between the pines, where there is precious little room to dodge. Hunt eight Cliffbuck in the pinewoods of {name:pinewood}, {zone_area:pinewood}, by day. A man can carry a load or climb a tree; asking for both seems unfair.

Acorn Hog keeps rooting through the meadow crossings and catching our cart wheels in the holes. Hunt eight Acorn Hog in the meadows of {name:meadows}, {zone_area:meadows}; they are out by day. We are trying to run a camp, and lately most of the work has been lifting carts.

Brook Hind is driving our porters away from the berry woods with more determination than sense. Hunt eight Brook Hind in the woodland of {name:berrywoods}, {zone_area:berrywoods}, by day. We need room to carry supplies through, and the animals have declined every reasonable request.

Crescent Stag keeps lowering its antlers at anyone carrying timber for the camp. Hunt eight Crescent Stag under the forest eaves of {name:eaves}, {zone_area:eaves}; they roam by day. I admire a firm stance until it starts holding up my shift.

Marrow Weevil swarms have made the woods miserable for the crew bringing supplies to camp. Hunt eight Marrow Weevil in the bone forest of {name:bonewood}, {zone_area:bonewood}, by day. I need my workers attending to their loads, not picking beetles out of their joints.

Quagga keeps charging the haulers crossing the plains, and the last load came back scattered over half a field. Hunt eight Quagga in the plains of {name:plains}, {zone_area:plains}; you will find them by day. We gave our word that those supplies would reach camp together.

Reed Tapir has been knocking our porters off their footing beneath the trees. Hunt eight Reed Tapir in the jungle of {name:canopy}, {zone_area:canopy}, by day. A dropped bundle is trouble enough before it lands in the water.

quests.notes: Round 58 camp hunt: one shared quest per camp band and clock, given by the camps' foremen; a role near the camp (the camps' level belt L21-23) that the zone's own quests do not hunt yet, met by day.
